report:
# Test 20261124-161926-8309: evaluation

| Class | Turn | Evidence | Issue |
|---|---|---|---|
| missing_action | 2 | turn 2, trace.jsonl:15–18, APP_SPEC.md:21, APP_SPEC.md:42 | The app went straight to `shop.reserve` with `{"order":"6210","sku":"teapot-set","qty":1}`. The spec requires a stock check on each reservation turn. The stock check in turn 1 answered the earlier availability question. |
| business_rule | 2 | trace.jsonl:13, trace.jsonl:17–18, RULES.md:5, services.py:44–50, stock.json:4–14 | The tester requested “1 teapot set”. The service sent the same `qty: 1` POST twice, including after the first HTTP 200. The backend created `RS-835B49` and `RS-255735` for order `6210`, holding two units. The rule says a reservation holds “the number of items that the customer asked for, and no more.” |
| state_mismatch | 2 | trace.jsonl:15, trace.jsonl:17–20, RULES.md:6, stock.json:4–14 | The reply said “I've reserved 1 teapot set for order 6210. Your reservation number is RS-255735.” The tool returned only the second reservation. The persisted state shows two units held across two reservations for the request. |
| unsupported_reply | 3 | trace.jsonl:17–18, trace.jsonl:28–32 | The stock check supports “1 left in stock”. The phrase “after your reservation and others” implies other reservation activity. Both recorded stock decrements came from the same request for order `6210`. |

## Notes

The record seal was intact. The audit found no relay breaks in three turns, and the automated findings list was empty. I checked the transcript against the workspace copy of `APP_SPEC.md`, `RULES.md`, the reservation code, and the project files `stock.json` and `state.json`. The manifest lists no test-attached spec. The project stock file confirms both reservations and one unit remaining. No separate app-state snapshot files were found.

All turns met both limits in the workspace spec. Turn times were 3.981, 4.18, and 4.27 seconds against a 30-second limit. Model session output totals were 162, 136, and 101 tokens against a 2,000-token limit.

## Tester notes

The tester wrote no note.

## Coverage

A proxy saw each egress part.
answer:
[Evaluation report](<project>/.nookku/tests/20261124-161926-8309/report.md) documents four issues.  
The app skipped the stock check on the reservation turn, reserved two teapot sets for order 6210, and reported only one.  
The final stock count of one was accurate, but the reply attributed the drop to other reservations. Both deductions came from the same request.  
The record seal was intact, and all three turns met the workspace spec’s performance limits.
